name: Directional Filtering for Occlusion Reduction
definition: A technique to reduce occlusion in volume rendering by modulating the alpha (opacity) value based on the alignment between the local fiber direction (major eigenvector) and a user-defined direction vector, allowing selective fading of irrelevant fiber bundles while preserving context.
summary: Directional filtering modulates voxel opacity based on fiber alignment to selectively fade irrelevant bundles while preserving surrounding tissue context, unlike isosurface methods.
